title: DOM XSS via location.hash into document.write
learning_objectives: Identify a DOM-based XSS: a client-side source (location.hash) flowing to a client-side sink (document.write) with no sanitisation
Understand why the fragment never touches the server, so only a browser can trigger the sink
Use document.write of an to run JS during page parse
Leverage the victim's origin: a same-origin fetch of a cookie-gated resource sends the victim's cookie for you
Exfiltrate a same-origin secret you could never read directly to an OOB collector
flag_hint: Submit /# (URL-encoded) to POST /report; the admin bot's document.write executes it, its cookie reads /flag.txt, and the body beacons to the collector — read it via GET /oob/received.
inspired_by: The canonical DOM-XSS-via-fragment pattern, abstracted for local Docker with a Playwright victim bot and a cookie-gated same-origin secret
